The liveness branch replaces a dead child with no attempt budget, backoff or failure memo, so a child that dies immediately after each spawn (for example a checkout the child cannot import, whose stderr goes to DEVNULL at spawn_served_child) starts one fresh interpreter per guarded call, which is the per-call import cost the persistent child exists to remove and which is silent in the log.
